settings.heading: Plug & Play Installation Guide
settings.content:
1. Ensure your vehicle ignition and lights are turned off.
2. Remove the factory dust cover and unplug old halogen bulb.
3. Insert Electro NightEye LED into the socket collar and twist to lock.
4. Re-attach dust seal and plug in the OEM connector. Zero splicing required!

settings.question: Will these bulbs trigger a Canbus dashboard error light?
settings.answer: No. Electro NightEye LEDs feature integrated micro-decoders that replicate OEM halogen resistance, ensuring 99.9% error-free operation without ECU warning lights or flickering.

settings.question: How difficult is the installation process?
settings.answer: It is completely plug-and-play. They are engineered to 1:1 OEM dimensions. Simply unplug your old factory bulb and twist in the Electro LED. Most drivers complete installation in under 10 minutes per headlight.

settings.question: What does the 2-Year Warranty cover?
